answer: In PoA, each bonded identity posts collateral in a vault, while attestations expose shared control through correlated equivocation. If k identities coordinate conflicting votes, the slashing schedule charges O(k^2), making joint misconduct costlier than independent failures. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the sybil controller, so apparent scale becomes a liability; pigment and inlet are metadata, not exemptions.
